arabic_blocks: [836] حدثنا أبو اليمان قال: أخبرنا شعيب قال: حدثنا أبو الزناد أن عبد الرحمن بن هرمز الأعرج مولى ربيعة بن الحارث حدثه أنه سمع أبا هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه أنه سمع رسول الله ﷺ يقول: نحن الآخرون السابقون يوم القيامة بيد أنهم أوتوا الكتاب من قبلنا ثم هذا يومهم الذي فرض عليهم فاختلفوا فيه فهدانا الله فالناس لنا فيه تبع اليهود غدا والنصارى بعد غد
english_blocks: Abu al-Yaman related to us. He said: Shu‘ayb informed us. He said: Abu al-Zinad related to us that ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz al-A‘raj, the freedman of Rabi‘ah ibn al-Harith, related to him that he heard Abu Hurayrah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him:

He heard the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, say, “We are the last, but the foremost on the Day of Resurrection, although they were given the Book before us. Then this was their day which was made obligatory for them, but they differed over it, so Allah guided us. The people follow us in this: the Jews tomorrow and the Christians the day after tomorrow.”

arabic_blocks: [838] حدثنا عبد الله بن محمد بن أسماء قال: أخبرنا جويرية عن مالك عن الزهري عن سالم بن عبد الله بن عمر عن ابن عمر رضى الله تعالى عنهما أن عمر بن الخطاب بينما هو قائم في الخطبة يوم الجمعة إذ دخل رجل من المهاجرين الأولين من أصحاب النبي ﷺ فناداه عمر أية ساعة هذه قال إني شغلت فلم أنقلب إلى أهلي حتى سمعت التأذين فلم أزد أن توضأت، فقال والوضوء أيضا وقد علمت أن رسول الله ﷺ كان يأمر بالغسل
english_blocks: ‘Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Asma’ related to us. He said: Juwayriyah informed us, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Salim ibn ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Umar, from Ibn ‘Umar, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both:

While ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab was standing delivering the sermon on Friday, a man from the earliest Emigrants among the Companions of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, entered. ‘Umar called out to him, “What time is this?” He said, “I was occupied and did not return to my family until I heard the call to prayer. I did no more than perform ablution.” He said, “And only ablution as well! You know that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, used to command bathing.”

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Bathing on Friday is obligatory for every male who has reached puberty.”

arabic_blocks: [840] حدثنا علي قال: حدثنا حرمي بن عمارة قال: حدثنا شعبة عن أبي بكر ابن المنكدر قال: حدثني عمرو بن سليم الأنصارى قال أشهد على أبي سعيد قال أشهد على رسول الله ﷺ قال: الغسل يوم الجمعة واجب على كل محتلم وأن يستن وأن يمس طيبا إن وجد قال عمرو أما الغسل فأشهد أنه واجب وأما الاستنان والطيب فالله أعلم أواجب هو أم لا ولكن هكذا في الحديث قال أبو عبد الله هو أخو محمد بن المنكدر ولم يسم أبو بكر هذا رواه عنه بكير بن الأشج وسعيد بن أبي هلال وعدة وكان محمد بن المنكدر يكنى بأبي بكر وأبي عبد الله
english_blocks: ‘Ali related to us. He said: Harami ibn ‘Umarah related to us. He said: Shu‘bah related to us, from Abu Bakr ibn al-Munkadir, who said: ‘Amr ibn Sulaym al-Ansari related to me:

He said: I testify that Abu Sa‘id said: I testify that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Bathing on Friday is obligatory for every male who has reached puberty, and cleaning the teeth with a toothstick, and applying perfume if it is available.”
‘Amr said: As for bathing, I testify that it is obligatory. As for cleaning the teeth and perfume, Allah knows best whether it is obligatory or not, but this is how it appears in the hadith.

Abu ‘Abdullah said: He is the brother of Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir. This Abu Bakr’s personal name was not given. Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj, Sa‘id ibn Abi Hilal and several others narrated this from him. Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir was known by the kunyahs Abu Bakr and Abu ‘Abdullah.

arabic_blocks: [841] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال: أخبرنا مالك عن سمي مولى أبي بكر ابن عبد الرحمن عن أبي صالح السمان عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: من اغتسل يوم الجمعة غسل الجنابة ثم راح فكأنما قرب بدنة ومن راح في الساعة الثانية فكأنما قرب بقرة ومن راح في الساعة الثالثة فكأنما قرب كبشا أقرن ومن راح في الساعة الرابعة فكأنما قرب دجاجة ومن راح في الساعة الخامسة فكأنما قرب بيضة فإذا خرج الإمام حضرت الملائكة يستمعون الذكر
english_blocks: ‘Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us. He said: Malik informed us, from Sumayy, the freedman of Abu Bakr ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Salih al-Samman, from Abu Hurayrah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him:

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Whoever bathes on Friday with the bath for major ritual impurity and then goes, it is as though he has offered a camel. Whoever goes in the second hour, it is as though he has offered a cow. Whoever goes in the third hour, it is as though he has offered a horned ram. Whoever goes in the fourth hour, it is as though he has offered a hen. Whoever goes in the fifth hour, it is as though he has offered an egg. When the imam comes out, the angels attend to listen to the remembrance.”

The selected الذكر is translated as remembrance without replacing it with an explanatory sermon label. Modern print reference: 881.

He said: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “No man bathes on Friday, purifies himself as much as he can, applies some of his oil or some perfume from his household, then goes out without separating two people, then prays what has been allotted to him, then listens silently when the imam speaks, without being forgiven for what lies between that Friday and the other Friday.”

‘Umar ibn al-Khattab saw a silk robe at the door of the mosque. He said, “Messenger of Allah, if only you bought this and wore it on Friday and for delegations when they come to you.” The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Only someone who has no share in the Hereafter wears this.” Then robes of this kind came to the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and he gave ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, one of them. ‘Umar said, “Messenger of Allah, you have clothed me with it, yet you said what you said about ‘Utarid’s robe.” The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “I did not clothe you with it for you to wear it.” So ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, gave it to a brother of his in Makkah who was a polytheist.

english_blocks: Bishr ibn Muhammad related to us. He said: ‘Abdullah informed us. He said: Yunus informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Salim ibn ‘Abdullah informed us, from Ibn ‘Umar, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both:
The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Each of you is a shepherd.”

Al-Layth added: Yunus said: Ruzayq ibn Hukaym wrote to Ibn Shihab, while I was with him that day in Wadi al-Qura, “Do you think I should hold the Friday prayer?” Ruzayq was in charge of land which he cultivated, and on it was a group of Black people and others. Ruzayq was then in charge of Aylah. Ibn Shihab wrote, while I was listening, commanding him to hold the Friday prayer and informing him that Salim had related to him that ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Umar said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, say:

“Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you is responsible for his flock. The imam is a shepherd and is responsible for his flock. A man is a shepherd in his household, and he is responsible for his flock. A woman is a shepherd in her husband’s house and is responsible for her flock. A servant is a shepherd over his master’s property and is responsible for his flock.”
He said: I think he also said:
“A man is a shepherd over his father’s property and is responsible for his flock. Each of you is a shepherd and is responsible for his flock.”

They were given the Book before us, and we were given it after them. This is the day over which they differed, and Allah guided us. He said: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Allah Most High has a right upon every Muslim that he bathe on one day in every seven.”

Then he descended backwards and prostrated at the foot of the pulpit, then returned. When he finished, he turned to the people and said, ‘People, I only did this so that you would follow me and learn my prayer.’”

english_blocks: And Mahmud said: Abu Usamah related to us. He said: Hisham ibn ‘Urwah related to us. He said: Fatimah bint al-Mundhir informed me, from Asma’ bint Abi Bakr:

She said: I went in to ‘A’ishah, may Allah Most High be pleased with her, while the people were praying. I said, ‘What is happening with the people?’ She pointed her head towards the sky. I said, ‘A sign?’ She nodded her head, meaning yes. She said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, prolonged it greatly, until faintness overcame me. Beside me was a waterskin containing water, so I opened it and began pouring from it over my head. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, finished, and the sun had cleared. He addressed the people and praised Allah as He deserves, then said, ‘Now then.’ And she said: Some women of the Ansar made a noise, so I turned towards them to quiet them. I said to ‘A’ishah, ‘What did he say?’ She said: He said, ‘There is nothing that I had not been shown before that I have not seen at this place where I stand, even the Garden and the Fire. It has been revealed to me that you will be tried in the graves with a trial like, or close to, the trial of the false messiah. One of you will be approached and asked, “What do you know of this man?” As for the believer—or he said, the one who is certain; Hisham was unsure—he will say, “He is the Messenger of Allah. He is Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. He brought us clear proofs and guidance, so we believed, responded, followed and affirmed the truth.” He will be told, “Sleep, righteous one. We already knew that you did indeed believe in him.” As for the hypocrite—or he said, the doubter; Hisham was unsure—he will be asked, “What do you know of this man?” He will say, “I do not know. I heard people saying something, so I said it.”’
Hisham said: Fatimah did indeed tell it to me, and I retained it, except that she mentioned what would be made severe for him.
